cards.title: One locked spend authority: sessions, every cap and latch clears inside Budget
acceptance: case 1: open_session(art=tmp, name='S', cap=2, slot_attempt_cap=1, protected=['delivery/x'], authorization='t') called twice -> one start.json with jobs, charged, jobsDigest, protected hashes, sessionImageCap=2; second call returns the same record and copies before/ ledgers once

case 2: active session cap 2 with 2 images charged since start, Budget(tmp).reserve({...}) from ANY caller (no wave-script pre-check) -> RuntimeError SESSION_CAP raised under .budget.lock, usage.json unchanged
case 3: session slot_attempt_cap 1 and one row for scene X since start -> reserve(scene X) raises SESSION_SLOT_ATTEMPT_CAP; reserve(scene Y) succeeds

case 4: wave_image_caps {W:1} with one W charge, and agy weekly cap reached incl. external_known_charges -> spend.headroom(tmp, wave=W, provider='agy') returns blocking codes ['WAVE_IMAGE_CAP','PROVIDER_BUDGET_CAP'] and reserve raises the first of them (same code list, one function)

case 5: verify_session on a legacy A13/A14-shaped start-snapshot.json after editing an inherited ledger row -> ['HISTORY_CHANGED']; after changing a protected file -> ['PROTECTED_CHANGED:<path>']; untouched -> []

case 6: clear_latch(tmp, 'agy', job, diagnosis) where the job's cli-output.txt contains 'HTTP 429' -> raises QUOTA_OR_RATE_SIGNAL and history.json stop is unchanged; for a local 'cannot find the file' failure -> old stop archived to the session latches/ folder, stop cleared and a 'latch-cleared-local-failure' event appended, all under providers/.lock
case 7: python -m unittest test_providers test_pipeline test_waves test_d2_slice -> all pass unchanged (no ledger schema change; no session active means current behaviour)

tools/art/a14_generate.py:117 - A14 repeats the same caller-side check with a different snapshot path (line 118 raises SESSION_CAP)
tools/art/a14_session10.py:32 - session 10 hard-codes the cap as 40 instead of reading sessionImageCap, and checks it again as a literal at line 78
tools/art/d2_slice.py:271 - D2S counts usage['jobs'][start['jobs']:] against a module constant SESSION_CAP (line 28), copied again at 302 and 529

tools/art/d2_slice.py:530 - the project hard cap appears as a literal 450 (also 484, check_a14.py:46) although art/budget.json wave_hard_cap is the stated single authority (README.md 'one authority: art/budget.json')

tools/art/a13_prepare.py:12 - start-snapshot schema (jobs, charged, jobsDigest, protected, sessionImageCap, authorization) is re-authored per wave: a14_prepare.py:12, a14_session10.py:16, d2_slice.py:213, prepare_a12.py:8

tools/art/check_a13.py:72 - each wave's check re-implements HISTORY_CHANGED / PROTECTED / SESSION_CAP verification (check_a14.py:44-46, d2_slice.py:524-530, a14_session10.py:78)

cards.body:
## Summary
The art pipeline's spend safety is its most important invariant (README: one authority, art/budget.json; no retries; first quota latches), yet the rules that enforce it are scattered across Budget.reserve, ProviderBudget.available, providers.generate, and a hand-rolled session envelope that each wave script re-authors and checks from outside the run lock. Move every cap, the session envelope and latch clearing into one locked module so a new wave cannot spend past its authorization by forgetting a pre-check.

## Description
New tools/art/spend.py owns: open_session (idempotent start record + before/ ledger copies, the shape a13/a14/d2 already use), an active-session pointer, headroom(art, wave, provider, scene) returning every blocking code (project hard, weekly, target, scene attempts, wave cap, provider weekly incl. external charges, session cap, session slot attempts, spend stop, provider stop), verify_session (HISTORY_CHANGED, PROTECTED_CHANGED, SESSION_CAP, UNRESOLVED_RESERVATION) and clear_latch (refuses quota/rate/402 evidence, archives the old stop, clears under providers/.lock). Budget.reserve calls headroom inside .budget.lock and raises its first code; providers.generate drops its own wave-cap block. d2_slice, a13/a14 generate/prepare/check and a14_session10 call the module instead of re-implementing it. Legacy snapshot files load unchanged.

## Flow
- operator: d2_slice.py prepare -> spend.open_session(...)
- any caller -> providers.generate -> Budget.reserve -> spend.headroom under lock -> reserve or raise one code
- wave check -> spend.verify_session(start) -> code list
- d2_slice clear-latch/recover -> spend.clear_latch (locked, quota-refusing)

## Expected impact
Caller-side cap checks drop from 5 copies to 0; literal 450 caps from 3 to 0; unlocked history.json writes from 3 to 0. The next wave (Lio A15.1 art, per the W8 spark) declares a session in one call instead of copying ~40 lines of snapshot and guard code.

## Evaluation
Claim: every spend cap and latch clear is enforced in one locked function, and no wave script needs a pre-check.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (spend.py absent; reserve ignores sessions and wave caps)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - cd tools/art && python -m unittest test_spend test_providers test_pipeline test_waves test_d2_slice (temp art dirs, zero provider calls)
Result: better
Gate: architecture
cards.evidence: grep -n "sum(j['charged_images']" tools/art/*.py -> 38 hits across 17 files; sessionImageCap read/written in a13_generate.py:9, a13_prepare.py:14, a14_generate.py:118, a14_prepare.py:12, a14_session10.py:16, check_a13.py:76, d2_slice.py:213; literal 450 in d2_slice.py:484,530 and check_a14.py:46; history['providers']['agy']['stop']=None without lock at a14_session10.py:25, d2_slice.py:161, d2_slice.py:189; wave cap at providers.py:218-220 vs reserve at generate.py:67-91.

cards.title: art plan <wave>: per-slot next legal action and blocker, zero spend, zero writes
acceptance: case 1: spec whose digest matches a generated ledger row with intact archive -> plan row state 'resume', new_calls 0, next_command null
case 2: last row generated, no review file -> state 'needs-review', code HASH_BOUND_REJECTION_REQUIRED, next_command is the wave's review command for that job id
case 3: last row generated, reject review bound to its sha256, spec lacks correction_of -> state 'needs-correction' with the correction command; with correction_of set -> state 'ready'
case 4: providers ['agy','grok'], agy history stop set, grok available, no prior grok row -> state 'ready', provider 'grok', skipped [{'agy':'PROVIDER_STOP: ...'}]
case 5: one moderation-refused row and a spec with rewrite_of missing -> state 'blocked', code ONE_EXPLICIT_MODERATION_REWRITE_REQUIRED

case 6: parity - for each fixture above, providers.decide(spec, old, reviews, provider_state) is the function providers.generate uses before reserving; a stubbed generate (invoke patched to raise) raises/returns exactly the code plan reports
case 7: plan(tmp wave) leaves usage.json, providers/history.json and every review/grade file byte-identical and creates no lock file
premise: tools/art/pipeline.py:34 - the only status surface prints Budget().summary(): project totals, no provider latches, provider caps, wave caps or per-item state
tools/art/providers.py:216 - every pre-spend rule runs only after taking the exclusive .run.lock inside generate(); the operator learns a blocker by triggering a RuntimeError
tools/art/providers.py:221-245 - the decision (resume / moderation rewrite / hash-bound rejection / provider skip / repeat-provider skip) is inline in generate, so no read-only caller can ask it
tools/art/providers.py:232 - the hash-bound rejection is looked up only under art/waves/<wave>/reviews, which forces d2_slice to copy its own reviews there (d2_slice.py:285-286, 322)
tools/art/providers.py:240-241 - a slot silently skips a provider it already tried; the CLI prints nothing when that is the reason a call cannot happen

tools/art/d2_slice.py:541-550 - the current wave's CLI has prepare/call/normal/review/recover/clear-latch/build/check but no status or plan; the operator walks 17 slots (scenes(), d2_slice.py:96-122) blind to which is next under the family-proof and SLOT_ATTEMPTS rules (d2_slice.py:274-278)
cards.rollback: Commit 1 extracts providers.decide with generate calling it (behaviour-preserving, proven by test_providers + parity cases); commit 2 adds plan.py, the pipeline/d2_slice subcommands and README lines. Revert commit 2 then 1; no art/ data is written.
cards.runner_up: A wave-agnostic owner board that merges board.py/waves.build/covenant.board rows with compare-two-attempts and a hide-rejects filter (only A1b has filters, waves.py:199-216).
cards.body:
## Summary
The operator of a paid, latch-guarded image wave cannot see what the next legal call is. Add a read-only plan that lists every slot of a wave with its state (resume, needs-review, needs-correction, ready on provider P, blocked by CODE), the exact next command, and spend headroom, using the same decision function generate uses so the preview cannot drift.

## Description
Extract providers.generate's pre-reservation branch into providers.decide(spec, old_jobs, review_lookup, provider_state) returning {state, code, provider, skipped}; generate calls it unchanged in effect. plan.py loads briefs for a wave (art/briefs/<wave>/*.json, or d2_slice.scenes() via an adapter that adds the family-proof and slot-attempt rules), the ledger, provider history and reviews, and prints a table plus a JSON form (--json). It takes no lock and writes nothing. review_lookup is a parameter, so d2_slice can point it at waves/D2S/reviews directly in a later commit instead of copying files.

## Flow
- python tools/art/pipeline.py plan D2S (or d2_slice.py plan)
- table: slot | state | provider | blocker | next command; footer: headroom per cap
- operator runs the one printed command

## Expected impact
From trial-by-RuntimeError under an exclusive lock to one read-only command; a blocked slot names its code before any reservation, which matters because every failed or uncertain call stays charged with no refunds (README).

## Evaluation
Claim: plan reports, for every slot, the same decision generate would take, with zero writes.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no decide(), no plan.py)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - cd tools/art && python -m unittest test_plan test_providers (temp art dirs; invoke patched; zero provider calls)
Result: better
Gate: direction
cards.evidence: pipeline.py:12 sub.add_parser('status') -> pipeline.py:34 print(json.dumps(Budget().summary())); providers.py:216 'with lock(ART / .run.lock)' precedes the resume/rejection/provider checks at 221-245; providers.py:232 hard path waves/<wave>/reviews; d2_slice.py:285 comment 'providers.generate looks for the hash-bound rejection under the wave folder' + write at 286 and 322; d2_slice.py:541-550 command list has no status/plan.
